limits.policy: Respect published account quotas, do not rotate keys or bypass 429. Client pacing is visible, not attributed to model compute.

pricing.policy: List-price lower/upper bounds, not invoices; provider tokenizers differ. Missing usage is unpriced.

config.transport: aiohttp HTTP/1.1, one reused pool per model, 128 sockets, 15s idle keepalive, no retries, trust_env=False, models measured sequentially.
config.dns: System DNS resolved once per provider before calibration, frozen for this run. No custom address, endpoint, Host or TLS override. Lookup latency recorded separately.
config.load: Closed-loop sustained multi-question requests: a worker immediately requests another packet after response. Not an open-loop arrival/SLA capacity test.
config.measurement: 5s warmup then 30s fixed completion window by default. Drain responses are retained but not counted as window completions. Admitted cohort defines accuracy, latency, failure and cost.
config.cache: Finite original panels repeat; calibration and warmup may populate provider caches. Cache usage retained, no cold-cache claim.
config.synthetic_scope: routing_200 is a deterministic non-clinical 200-question board; performance only, never medical accuracy.
